claims.text: The frame never stated WHY this could be fast on Ampere, and the stated reason is the wrong one. Both proposed mechanisms contribute -- MoE sparsity (~3B active of 30B) AND DSpark speculation, which logged 3.06-5.42 mean acceptance length (c45). The frame should not attribute the speed to quantization, which is the Marlin fallback path and the slowest part of the stack.
